text:
maya: flagged by nightly secret-scan: plaintext partner ingest key appears in our logging pipeline for partner=lumen. redacted in-line. need containment+rotation.
infra-bot: secret-scan v4.1: match in prod-logging. report: https://internal/reports/4760000001 :warning:
raj: can you paste redacted line + last seen?
maya: `2026-03-24T02:10:12Z INFO post /ingest partner=lumen env=prod key=****REDACTED****` last seen 2026-03-24T02:10:12Z UTC
security_oncall: assume compromise. immediate: 1) pause ingest-task that uses the key, 2) create new secret and ask partner to rotate, 3) apply deny policy to old Vault path, 4) enable Vault & KMS audit sinks for the window, 5) open SEC-2026-210 and assign.
ida: storage: value is in KVv2 at secret/data/partners/lumen/ingest (ver=4). my recommendation: rotate (not rewrap). write new path secret/data/partners/lumen/ingest-rot1, generate new key, use KMS key projects/redwood-kms/.../partner-lumen for envelope, canary rollout. after canary, delete old versions.
raj: rewrap-only is tempting but low value; rotation necessary if plaintext appeared. also consider revoking long-lived tokens that can access the path.
security_oncall: proposed Vault deny policy:
```
vault policy write deny-lumen-old - <<'EOF'
path "secret/data/partners/lumen/ingest" {
  capabilities = ["deny"]
}
EOF
```
ida: i'll prepare a tiny terraform patch for policy + k8s roleBinding to point secret-agent at ingest-rot1. stage to staging first.
maya: partner ops says they need 12h to rotate on their side. we'll issue a short-lived proxy token for outbound with ttl=1h and document IOCs.
security_oncall: post-rotation checklist: delete old KV versions, revoke tokens with access, run detection across logs/storage for past 90d, export findings to SEC ticket, inform partner.
raj: rotation script (ops sketch):
```
NEW_KEY=$(openssl rand -hex 32)
vault kv put secret/data/partners/lumen/ingest-rot1 key=$NEW_KEY rotated_by=automation
# encrypt via gcloud kms encrypt --location global --keyring rw --key partner-lumen
# update configmap -> restart secret-agent (canary)
```
infra-bot: CI pipeline queued rotations/partners/lumen/4760000001 by raj
maya: assigning: maya->partner comms + log redaction window, raj->run rotation CI + secret-agent rollout, ida->tf + policy diff, security_oncall->incident tracking + audit hooks. will update SEC-2026-210. :thumbsup:
maya: after rotation run an automated grep across log buckets and artifact stores to confirm no other exposures and attach PoA to the incident.
security_oncall: reminder scheduled in 30m to check status. end of thread.
